fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 has driven economic diversification and reform, but rising global interest rates and geopolitical risks have sharply increased funding costs.
fields.summary_ko.1: Non-oil industries and SME sectors are most vulnerable to interest rate increases, with potential delays to some economic diversification projects.
fields.summary_ko.2: Enhanced transparency, reliable financial reporting, and rule of law are essential to sustain private investment attraction.
